_readme: T-1.1 SECTION-SET ASSERTION.
The harness cannot mount AliJeVroceERA5 itself — the selected date and the two
station signals are internal signals with no external entry point (the only date
control is prev/next-day buttons, TodayCard.tsx:90-110). So the harness mirrors
the page's composition instead, and a section added to the page would otherwise
be silently absent from the snapshot: no error, no miss, just a number that stops
being watched.
This file closes that hole. scripts/snapshot/main.mjs extracts every capitalised
JSX tag from code/ali-je-vroce-era5/AliJeVroceERA5.tsx and requires each one to
appear in exactly one bucket below. An unclassified tag FAILS THE RUN and no
snapshot is written.
Adding a section to the page is therefore a two-line change here plus whatever
capture it needs — and forgetting is not an option the harness allows.
`covered` entries name the harness unit that renders them, so the mirror is
auditable against the page rather than taken on trust.
LIMIT: this assertion sees CAPITALISED TAGS ONLY, so it is blind to numbers the

page renders itself in bare
/

— the distribution chart's title and footer
(AliJeVroceERA5.tsx:99-112) and the station count (:137-145). Those are covered
instead by the mirrored-source assertion in scripts/snapshot/main.mjs, which is
where both limits are written up in full.

TodayCard.captures: category, percentile, temperature, sample count, year range, the ERA5T/preliminarno badge, explain + footer copy, gauge and last-7 chart options

DistributionChart.captures: distribution curve points, percentile zone bands, cutoff plotlines

TodayTrendChart.captures: Theil-Sen slope, p-value, tau, n years, projection endpoints, and the current-year plotline label (TodayTrendChart.tsx:69-80) — a former clock leak that must now follow the pinned date

RegToolbar.captures: the control state the rest of the analysis panel is computed from (variable, method, window, day label)

RegScatterCard.captures: trend per decade, total change over record, significance label, fit description, per-year scatter and anomalies

RegYearRoundCard.captures: trend10 and p_val for all 365 days of the year, keyed MM-DD

StationMap.captures: station marker set. Displays no numbers of its own; rendered so the Highcharts topology fixture (StationMap.tsx:45-46) is actually exercised rather than merely recorded

HeroCardsPanel.captures: impact category, trend headline number, verdict copy, significance stars, sample counts

Era5SeasonHeatmapChart.captures: per-season per-year average, percentile, category, rank

SpeiHeatmapChart.captures: national SPEI per season-year, category, water balance, rank

SpeiTrendChartLazy.captures: per-station SPEI-3/SPEI-30 series and Theil-Sen trend parameters

Era5TropicalChart.captures: per-year counts, NB-GLM trend, and the highlighted current-year bar (TropicalChart.tsx:73-76) — the second former clock leak

MethodologyPanel.captures: the always-visible trust furniture — the derived station-count line (`{era5Stations.length} postaj`, the same figure global.meta.station_count and the map panel_header watch) and the correction-contact line. T-6.22 MOVED the methodology, glossary and references disclosures to standalone site pages (pages/methodology.md + pages/glossary.md); MethodologyPanel now renders ONLY this furniture line, so the former disclosure-summary capture is gone. The station count is the only rendered value here worth watching.

structural.Dashboard: Local layout wrapper for the whole page (AliJeVroceERA5.tsx:43). The harness mirrors its composition; it renders no numbers itself.
structural.FloatingStationChooser: The single below-hero location control (T-5.27 / D-26, RegressionPanel.tsx). Like TropControls, it displays no data of its own — it WRITES the regression store's location (s.setLoc), and that location drives every analysis capture (RegScatterCard title, RegYearRoundCard, tropical, season, hero). Its markup is a station list; the snapshot cannot scroll or interact with it and there is no rendered number to watch. The station it selects is pinned per case by cases.json analysis_loc (via syncLoc), exactly as before.
structural.UrlStateSync: The shareable URL query-state sync (T-5.29, RegressionPanel.tsx). Returns null — it renders NO DOM and no number: it mirrors the hero location + date signals into ?postaja=&dan= (history.replaceState) and re-reads them on popstate. There is nothing for the snapshot to watch, and by design there COULD NOT be: the harness mounts leaf components directly and never mounts Dashboard, so it never exercises window.location or history at all (this feature has no automated coverage — verified by hand, see PROGRESS T-5.29). Structural, like FloatingStationChooser.
structural.Era5Charts: Local layout wrapper for the lower sections (AliJeVroceERA5.tsx:207). Renders no numbers itself.
structural.DeferMount: T-5.71 defer + idle-prefetch wrapper (components/DeferMount.tsx). Renders NO numbers of its own — it holds a min-height placeholder until its child is scrolled near view (IntersectionObserver) or the idle queue reaches it, then mounts the child unchanged. Structural, like Show/Suspense. It is TRANSPARENT to this snapshot for two independent reasons: (1) the harness mounts every wrapped chart LEAF directly and never instantiates Dashboard/Era5Charts, so DeferMount never runs under the harness; (2) even if it did, jsdom exposes no IntersectionObserver, so the component reveals its child synchronously on mount. Its only footprint here is this structural classification.
structural.TropControls: Threshold and streak inputs (AliJeVroceERA5.tsx:181). Their VALUES are pinned in cases.json analysis_defaults and drive the tropical captures; the control markup itself displays no data.
structural.RegressionPanel: Context provider only (RegressionPanel.tsx:121). Supplies the analysis store to the cards, renders no DOM of its own.
structural.ErrorBoundary: solid-js control flow (T-5.1). Wraps each section's fetch consumer so a failed fetch shows a visible SectionError instead of vanishing or blanking the page. Renders its children unchanged on success (no DOM wrapper), so it is transparent to the happy-path snapshot; the error branch is never exercised by the fixtures.
structural.EmptyState: The shared no-data message (EmptyState.tsx, T-5.14), used as the <Show> fallback for the two SPEI sections. Renders the static common.no_data string only when a fetch resolved to no rows; every snapshot case has data, so this branch is never exercised by the fixtures and it captures no numbers of its own.
structural.SiteMeta: NOT a component. A type argument in createResource<SiteMeta> (AliJeVroceERA5.tsx:35) that the tag regex cannot distinguish from JSX. Classified explicitly rather than special-cased in the extractor, so the extractor stays dumb and auditable.

_t622_disclosures_moved_note: T-6.22 removed the GlossaryPanel and ReferencesPanel mounts from AliJeVroceERA5.tsx
and reduced MethodologyPanel to the closing trust-furniture line only. The methodology,
glossary and references DISCLOSURES became standalone plain-markdown site pages
(pages/methodology.md — which also carries the numbered references — and
pages/glossary.md), linked from the footer. GlossaryPanel/ReferencesPanel tags no
longer appear in the page, so their former 'structural' entries were deleted here or
assertSections() (scripts/snapshot/main.mjs:153) would fail on a stale bucket key.
MethodologyPanel stays in 'covered' (still mounted for the furniture); the harness
global.methodology capture dropped its `.methodology-summary` field with the disclosure.
_sea_level_excluded_note: T-4.21 removed the SeaLevelChart mount from AliJeVroceERA5.tsx — the sea-level
widget is GATED OUT of v1 per D-10 (unsound per-cm factors D-10b; SRTM DEM unfit
for 10cm increments D-10c). Its former 'excluded' entry was dropped here because
the tag no longer appears in the page and assertSections() fails on a stale bucket
It was never snapshotted: its figures — flooded hectares / affected buildings per
increment — came from /data/flood-stats.json plus the per-cm factors 20.77 ha and
14.13 buildings (SeaLevelWidget.tsx:56-57,109), none in the T-1.2 ERA5 fixture set.
ON UNPARK (D-10b/c resolved, widget cleared to launch): restore the mount in
AliJeVroceERA5.tsx, re-add a SeaLevelChart entry under 'excluded' here (or a
global.sea_level 'covered' unit if the fixture matrix is extended to cover
unattributed AR6 tables), T-4.12 (flood asset passthrough), T-5.6 (lazy-load 162KB).
